slots.title: Share image: predictions
where: /predictions and /predictions/[slug] share card (planned: metadata in app/predictions/page.tsx and [slug]/page.tsx; not wired yet)
slots.css: 1200×630 as delivered; shown 300–600 wide in link previews
slots.crop: Safe area is the centre 1080×566. The left 45% stays calm and dark for the title composited later; the price bar, tokens and crystal ball live in the right 55%.
slots.lighting: neon: hololive blue on one side, warm orange on the other (not market green/red: a call is not a price move)
slots.fallback: None today: link previews show the page title only.
slots.brief: A betting board for calls: a big split price bar glowing hololive blue (#3fb8f5) on one side and warm orange on the other, floating yes/no ballot tokens, a crystal ball on a small stand reflecting a stock chart, faint probability curves across a dark ink (#0a0c11) background. Flat shapes, halftone bloom, bright enough to read as a thumbnail.
slots.notes: No text or numbers. To wire: serve at /art/og/predictions.png, set metadataBase, add metadata.openGraph.images. A per-market card could later composite the market title over this plate. Same props (crystal ball, yes/no tokens, tote bars) as predictions-hero.

slots.title: Predictions: header backdrop
where: /predictions, /predictions/portfolio and /predictions/create → components/predictions/shell/predictions-frame.tsx page header, behind the kicker, title, blurb (left) and the aside (right). Not on /predictions/manage, not on market pages (they use a bare frame)
slots.css: page width (up to 1680) × ~110–150; cover at object-position 80% 50%; 60% opacity
slots.crop: The UI masks it: fully transparent over the left 25%, fading in until 75% (phones: transparent to 35%, solid at 100%). Everything interesting lives in the right 40%, vertically centred: at desktop widths only the middle ~50% of the height shows. The aside (cash, stats) can sit over the right side, so keep it low-contrast.
slots.lighting: neon: thin glowing blue bars and a little warm orange on dark ink
slots.fallback: Nothing visible beyond a faint blue halftone at the right; the header text is unaffected.
slots.brief: A wide, low strip: a long glowing tote board of probability bars and small yes/no tokens receding to the right, a faint crystal ball silhouette and a few floating ballot slips in the right third, soft haze. Dark ink (#0a0c11) with hololive blue (#3fb8f5) and a little warm orange. The left half is plain dark ink.
slots.notes: No text or numbers. Sits on the theme background at 60%: in light mode it reads as a grey-blue band on the right, so keep it light-weight (thin lines, no large bright areas).
